The server moved

  
If the repository now has a new address (a new server name, or https instead of http), point this working copy
    at it. Nothing changes on the server, and your local changes stay. svn checks that it's the same repository.

  

  

  
Other working copies of this repository need moving too: do this in each.

  






  
Switch to URL

  
Any folder of the same repository: a branch, a tag, or an older layout. Your local changes come along.

  

  






  
Ignore

  

  
  
  
  
This changes the folder's ignore list (a property). Commit that change so everyone ignores the same files.

  






  
Changelist

  
A changelist groups files under a name, so you can tick and commit them together, apart from your other changes. Only this working copy knows about it; committing a file takes it out.

  

  

    

  
  






  
Properties

  
Settings svn keeps with a file or folder. Changes here are local: commit them so everyone gets them.
